summary: Tested public portfolio API and core desktop UI flows. Portfolio and enquiry API tests passed; archive, project routing, showreel state, and responsive navigation were exercised. Enquiry UI submission was not conclusively completed because the styled coverage checkbox could not be targeted reliably in Playwright.

integration_issues.issue: Automated UI submission was blocked when targeting coverage selection: the checkbox input is intentionally display:none and text locator did not resolve reliably. API POST itself passed independently.

action_items: Add descriptive data-testid attributes to each coverage option label/control so the styled checkbox interaction is directly testable.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact coverage controls rely on hidden inputs without dedicated test IDs, making the required enquiry flow difficult to verify robustly.

success_rate.frontend: 75% of exercised flows (archive, project, showreel passed; contact UI inconclusive)

seed_data_creation: Created two TEST-prefixed enquiries through API/UI attempts for regression testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: API portfolio/enquiry validation passed against public URL. Desktop home/archive/project/showreel passed. Re-test contact form using a dedicated coverage label test ID, then verify success confirmation and mobile overflow.
rca of the issue: The coverage checkbox input is hidden via CSS (.check input{display:none}) and has no data-testid; generic text lookup did not resolve the label reliably in the rendered SPA. This is primarily a testability gap, not evidence that the backend integration fails.
